commit_message:
[LIT] Migrate runtime lit config to the internal shell

## Summary

Switches `runtime/lit.cfg.py` to lit's internal shell and drops the
`execute_external` / `force_execute_external` workaround.

Part of #24607. This is the first of the seven configs listed there;
migrating one config at a time keeps the failure set scoped and reviewable.

The internal shell does not implement subshells, so the `( ... )` wrappers in
`flags_test.txt` were parsed as a command named `(` and failed with exit code
127. Two kinds of RUN lines needed updating:

- 26 lines wrapped a single command in `( ... )` before piping it to
  FileCheck. The subshell was redundant there and the parentheses are simply
  removed.
- 3 lines used `( cmd 2>&1 || [[ $? == 1 ]] )` to tolerate an expected non-zero
  exit. These now use `not`, which is the idiomatic spelling for
  expected-failure RUN lines and additionally asserts that the command really
  does fail. `not` is declared in the test suite's tools, matching the existing
  usage in `tools/test/BUILD.bazel`.

No test coverage is dropped: the same commands run with the same FileCheck
prefixes.

## Testing

```sh
ctest -R "flags_test.txt.test|modules/check/test/(failure|success|unavailable).mlir.test"
```

All 4 lit tests covered by `runtime/lit.cfg.py` pass on the internal shell,
matching the pre-change baseline:

```
1/4 Test #1239: iree/base/tooling/flags_test.txt.test ...........   Passed
2/4 Test #1310: iree/modules/check/test/failure.mlir.test .......   Passed
3/4 Test #1311: iree/modules/check/test/success.mlir.test .......   Passed
4/4 Test #1312: iree/modules/check/test/unavailable.mlir.test ...   Passed

100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 4
```

The three `modules/check` tests use plain pipelines and needed no changes.

To confirm the rewritten `not` lines are still executed rather than silently
skipped, I temporarily corrupted an expected `UNKNOWN-FLAG` pattern and
verified the test fails, then restored it.

Verified locally on macOS/arm64 only; relying on CI for the Linux and Windows
configurations.

Signed-off-by: Zohaib Shah <zohaib.shah.2047@gmail.com>
name: pr-greeter

commit_message:
[LLVMGPU] Add NVVM paged attention pipeline test (#24770)

## Summary

Adds NVVM compile-time pipeline coverage for paged decode attention.

Part of #24766.

The test follows the existing ROCm paged-attention coverage in
`pipeline_vector_distribute_reduction_gfx942.mlir`, adapted for CUDA's
32-thread subgroups.

- Adds an NVVM `VectorDistribute` testcase covering dynamic page tables,
paged KV gathers, causal masking, and `online_attention` lowering.
- Uses an explicit CUDA layout with 128-thread workgroups and 32-thread
subgroups.

## Testing
```sh
/workspace/iree-build/tools/iree-opt --split-input-file \
  --iree-codegen-llvmgpu-nvvm-lowering-pipeline="include-llvm-lowering=false" \
  compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/LLVMGPU/test/NVVM/pipeline_vector_distribute_paged_attention.mlir \
  | /workspace/iree-build/llvm-project/bin/FileCheck \
      compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/LLVMGPU/test/NVVM/pipeline_vector_distribute_paged_attention.mlir

Signed-off-by: weimin023 <tnwilly@gmail.com>
